name: qlrisk_price_cds_index
title: Price a CDSIndex
description:
Price one CDS Index (qlrisk CDSIndex).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, recovery_pct=40, reference, coupon_bp=100, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, is_buyer.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000, "reference": "GLOBEX"} gives NPV 49,448.54 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
